author: Inside Edition
description: There's outrage today over what conservative firebrand Megyn Kelly is saying about Christina Applegate. The "Anchorman" star said this week that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis, and doesn’t know the cause of her medical condition. Many reacted with sympathy, but Kelly called Applegate's health struggles a "wild goose chase."
title: Megyn Kelly Calls Christina Applegate's Health Struggles A 'Wild Goose Chase'

author: Inside Edition
description: A heartbroken family is demanding justice in connection with the killing of 46-year-old Koran Irvine in an alleged road rage shooting. It happened on the George Washington Bridge connecting New York City and New Jersey. The suspect is 62-year-old retired police detective Victor Romero. He pled not guilty to a manslaughter charge. Irvine's family showed up at court. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports from the courthouse.
title: At Courthouse, Family Of Alleged Road Rage Shooting Victim Demands Justice

author: Inside Edition
description: Surveillance video captured the moment a Florida man allegedly attempted to kidnap a young girl in a parking lot Monday afternoon. It happened at a gas station just outside Miami when a girl, who police say is 13, was approached by a man wearing a bike helmet. He put his arm around the child and pulled her away, but she was able to break free and run inside the station's convenience store, according to reports. The suspect was later arrested.
title: Alleged Kidnapping Attempt Caught on Camera

author: Inside Edition
description: Andres is a Colombian immigrant who teaches dance and works as a dancer in New York City's Washington Heights neighborhood. He just got married last month, and he and his wife, Claire, were scheduled to fly to California last week to visit her parents. But as they prepared to board a plane at JFK Airport, they were surrounded by ICE agents. Andres is now being held at a detainment center. His wife and their dance community are trying to free him.
title: Beloved Dance Teacher And Newlywed Detained By ICE

author: Inside Edition
description: Live action art is stopping people in their tracks. This is the scene in a public square in Tehran, Iran. An artist, wearing a mask resembling US President Donald Trump, along with a signature suit and red tie, interacts with the crowd from the makeshift cell hovering above ground. Many Iranians are stopping to take photos of the unlikely prisoner. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Iranian Art Installation Features Donald Trump In A Jail Cell

author: Inside Edition
description: An entire neighborhood is gripped by fear after a wave of break-ins by a gang wearing masks. Fed up neighbors in Ladera Heights, a suburb of Los Angeles, have banded together to try to stop the crime wave. They organized their own neighborhood patrols because they say the sheriff's department can’t adequately patrol their blocks. Each day neighbors can be found patrolling their streets.
title: Neighbors Band Together To Organize Patrol After Wave Of Break-Ins

author: Inside Edition
description: Red wolves are among the most endangered mammals in the world, with only one known wild population remaining in eastern North Carolina.
title: Nearly Extinct Wolf Species Gets An Airlift #shorts
